title: Analyzing Occupational Licensing Across Nations
title_zh: 跨国职业许可制度分析
authors: Jonathan S. Hartley, Morris M. Kleiner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Relatively little is known about occupational licensing across nations. Despite a large literature on occupational licensing in the United States, cross-national evidence remains scarce, especially for developing economies. We assemble harmonized estimates of licensing prevalence for 44 countries by combining new nationally representative surveys (including newly conducted nationally representative surveys for a number of previously unstudied countries) for several Latin American, African, Asian, European, and North American estimates. We document substantial cross-country dispersion in occupational licensing prevalence, ranging from roughly 14 percent of workers in Denmark to more than 40 percent in India and South Africa, the two most heavily licensed labor markets in our sample. Across countries, licensed workers generally earn higher wages than comparable unlicensed workers, with pooled Mincerian regressions indicating licensing wage premia ranging from roughly 6 to 19 percent depending on weighting and specification choices. Occupational licensing prevalence is also negatively associated with GDP per capita and governance quality, and positively associated with informal employment. While these relationships are descriptive rather than causal, they suggest that occupational licensing may be intertwined with broader institutional characteristics affecting labor market efficiency, formal-sector participation, and long-run economic development.
abstract_zh: 关于各国职业许可的研究相对较少。尽管美国已有大量关于职业许可的文献，但跨国证据仍然稀缺，尤其是针对发展中经济体。我们通过整合新的全国代表性调查（包括针对多个此前未被研究的国家新开展的全国代表性调查），为拉丁美洲、非洲、亚洲、欧洲和北美的44个国家构建了统一的职业许可普及率估计值。我们记录了各国职业许可普及率的显著差异，从丹麦约14%的工人到印度和南非超过40%——这两个样本中职业许可程度最高的劳动力市场。跨国数据显示，持有职业许可的工人通常比未持许可的同类工人获得更高工资，混合明瑟回归表明，根据权重和模型设定选择的不同，职业许可工资溢价约为6%至19%。职业许可普及率还与人均GDP和治理质量呈负相关，与非正规就业呈正相关。尽管这些关系是描述性而非因果性的，但它们表明职业许可可能与影响劳动力市场效率、正规部门参与度及长期经济发展的更广泛制度特征相互交织。

title: Mergers in the Presence of Adverse Selection
title_zh: 逆向选择下的企业并购
abstract: In the presence of adverse selection, mergers can increase welfare through a reduction in inefficient sorting. I characterize the sorting externality internalized between merging firms in a tractable discrete choice model. Mergers benefit consumers when the firms are small, willingness to pay is moderately increasing in cost, and consumer costs are skewed. Applying the model to the non‐group health insurance market, 13% of potential mergers would improve consumer surplus. In markets where the sorting distortion exceeds $5 per person, nearly one‐third of mergers improve consumer surplus, highlighting the importance of considering adverse selection in merger evaluation.
abstract_zh: 在逆向选择存在的情况下，并购可以通过减少低效分类来提高福利。我在一个易于处理的离散选择模型中刻画了并购企业之间内部化的分类外部性。当企业规模较小、支付意愿随成本适度递增且消费者成本呈偏态分布时，并购对消费者有利。将该模型应用于非团体健康保险市场，13%的潜在并购将改善消费者剩余。在分类扭曲超过每人5美元的市场中，近三分之一的并购会提升消费者剩余，这凸显了在并购评估中考虑逆向选择的重要性。

title: Planning Capital and Discovery-Based Learning-by-Doing: Investment as Staged Discovery in the Hyperscale Era
title_zh: 规划资本与基于发现的干中学：超大规模时代的投资作为分阶段发现
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper treats frontier investment as staged discovery. Firms invest through sequences of costly inquiry stages before deciding whether and how to realize value. At each stage, a firm may sharpen its diagnostic understanding, choose what question to ask, embody that question in a costly action, and interpret the answer that action produces. The answer changes what the firm knows, what it can do next, and how costly future inquiry will be. Successful histories can also carry over to later related problems, making the firm a better learner beyond the current investment path. The paper calls the resulting asset planning capital in firm form. Planning capital is the accumulated diagnostic understanding a firm has built through costly inquiry and operation: understanding of technologies, processes, customers, tools, partners, failures, constraints, and opportunities, together with the capacity to keep learning. It becomes valuable because it helps the firm choose what to investigate, make the question answerable, interpret what happened, and carry what it learned into later investment stages. Building on classical investment theory, R&D models, real-options theory, venture-capital models, classical learning-by-doing, the paper develops a model of investment as staged discovery. The AI and semiconductor frontier makes this asset visible. Firms are being valued and funded for more than the physical capacity they already own. Chips, fabs, data centers, cloud platforms, power commitments, and model systems matter because they carry traces of accumulated learning and because their use generates more learning. They let firms train models, test demand, expose bottlenecks, improve yields, qualify customers, integrate tools, and discover which complements are missing. The current buildout is therefore investment in capacity and in the institutional learning system that makes capacity more valuable over time. The framework explains why production systems, tool systems, research paths, sovereign capability programs, and infrastructure sponsorship belong in the same analysis. They are different institutional forms through which planning capital is accumulated. The paper treats terminal realization value in reduced form and focuses on the discovery process that precedes it: how institutions build capacity, learn from using it, and turn accumulated diagnostic understanding into an advantage in the next round of investment.
abstract_zh: 本文将前沿投资视为分阶段发现的过程。企业通过一系列成本高昂的探究阶段进行投资，随后再决定是否以及如何实现价值。在每个阶段，企业可以深化其诊断性理解，选择要探究的问题，将该问题体现于一项成本高昂的行动中，并解读该行动所产生的答案。答案会改变企业已知的信息、下一步能做什么以及未来探究的成本。成功的经验还可以延续到后续的相关问题，使企业在当前投资路径之外成为更好的学习者。本文将由此产生的资产称为企业形式的规划资本。规划资本是企业通过成本高昂的探究与运营所积累的诊断性理解：对技术、流程、客户、工具、合作伙伴、失败、约束与机遇的理解，以及持续学习的能力。它之所以有价值，是因为它帮助企业选择要调查什么、使问题可回答、解读所发生之事，并将所学带入后续投资阶段。本文基于经典投资理论、研发模型、实物期权理论、风险投资模型以及经典干中学理论，构建了一个将投资视为分阶段发现的模型。人工智能与半导体前沿使这一资产变得可见。企业的估值与融资依据已超越其已拥有的物理产能。芯片、晶圆厂、数据中心、云平台、电力承诺与模型系统之所以重要，是因为它们承载着积累的学习痕迹，且其使用能产生更多学习。它们让企业能够训练模型、测试需求、暴露瓶颈、提升良率、认证客户、集成工具，并发现哪些互补要素缺失。因此，当前的产能建设既是对产能的投资，也是对制度性学习系统的投资，后者使产能随时间推移更具价值。该框架解释了为何生产系统、工具系统、研究路径、主权能力计划与基础设施资助应被纳入同一分析。它们是规划资本得以积累的不同制度形式。本文以简化形式处理终端实现价值，并聚焦于其前的发现过程：机构如何建设产能、从使用中学习，并将积累的诊断性理解转化为下一轮投资中的优势。

title: The evolution of patriotism
title_zh: 爱国主义的发展演变
abstract: This paper presents an evolutionary model of patriotism. The state interacts with a population of citizens who may differ in their levels of patriotism, reflecting how much they care about the state. Citizens’ patriotism is subject to evolutionary pressure in the long run. Under complete information, if the state’s payoff function exhibits strategic complementarity, patriotism can emerge through evolution. In the presence of incomplete information, however, patriotism fails to thrive. Despite this, if citizens can costlessly disclose their levels of patriotism to the state in a truthful but potentially imprecise manner, full information revelation can be achieved under certain monotonicity conditions—one of which can be derived from the supermodularity of the interaction between the state and citizens—thus allowing patriotism to evolve in a manner similar to the complete information case.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个关于爱国主义的演化模型。国家与一群公民互动，这些公民的爱国主义程度可能不同，反映了他们对国家的关心程度。公民的爱国主义在长期中受到演化压力的影响。在完全信息条件下，如果国家的收益函数具有策略互补性，爱国主义可以通过演化过程产生。然而，在不完全信息条件下，爱国主义无法繁荣发展。尽管如此，如果公民能够以真实但可能不精确的方式，向国家无成本地披露其爱国主义水平，则在某些单调性条件下——其中一种条件可从国家与公民互动的超模性推导得出——可以实现完全信息揭示，从而使爱国主义以类似于完全信息情况的方式演化。

title: Peer Learning, Enforcement, and Reputation
title_zh: 同伴学习、执行与声誉
authors: Yi Chen, Kai Du, Phillip Stocken, Zhe Wang
abstract: We study a two‐period learning model where a sequentially rational regulator builds a reputation for strict enforcement and self‐interested firms test the regulator's enforcement propensity through their misconduct. In the transparent setting, where misconduct and enforcement are observable between the firms, the regulator's reputation concern endogenously creates positive or negative enforcement externalities between the firms. When the reputation concern is strong, the enforcement externalities are negative and dominate the information externalities, encouraging misconduct. Otherwise, both externalities are positive and deter misconduct. Although a strong reputation always benefits the regulator in the opaque setting, it often backfires in a transparent setting.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一个两期学习模型，其中具有序贯理性特征的监管者致力于建立严格执法的声誉，而自利的企业则通过其不当行为来试探监管者的执法倾向。在透明环境下（企业间可观察到不当行为与执法行为），监管者的声誉关切会内生地在企业间产生正向或负向的执法外部性。当声誉关切较强时，执法外部性为负向且主导信息外部性，从而助长不当行为；反之，两种外部性均为正向，能够抑制不当行为。尽管在非透明环境下，强大的声誉始终有利于监管者，但在透明环境下，这种声誉往往会产生适得其反的效果。

title: Voting on Public Goods: Citizens vs Shareholders
title_zh: 公共产品投票：公民与股东
authors: Robin Döttling, Doron Levit, Nadya Malenko, Magdalena Rola-Janicka
abstract: We study the interplay between a “one person-one vote” political system and a “one share-one vote” corporate governance regime. If shareholders push firms for more prosocial policies, political backlash may arise, undoing these initiatives. If public policy is frictionless, shareholder democracy becomes irrelevant: the political system fully offsets shareholder influence. With public policy frictions, prosocial corporations can mitigate regulatory shortcomings and enhance corporate public goods provision. Nevertheless, shareholder democracy can hurt citizens due to the representation problem: it favors the preferences of the wealthy. Investor diversification, pass-through voting, and corporate greenwashing have important implications for these trade-offs of shareholder democracy. (JEL D62, D72, G28, G34, G38, H23)

title: Monetary Policy and Endogenous Financial Crises
title_zh: 货币政策与内生金融危机
authors: F Boissay, F Collard, J Galí, C Manea
abstract: What are the channels through which monetary policy affects financial stability? Can (and should) central banks prevent financial crises by deviating from price stability? To what extent may monetary policy itself unintentionally breed financial vulnerabilities? We answer these questions using a New Keynesian model with capital accumulation and endogenous financial crises due to adverse selection and moral hazard in credit markets. Our findings are threefold. First, monetary policy affects the probability of a crisis both in the short run (via aggregate demand) and in the medium run (via capital accumulation). Second, the central bank can reduce the incidence of crises in the medium run by tolerating higher inflation volatility in the short run. Third, prolonged periods of loose monetary policy followed by a sharp tightening can lead to financial crises.

title: Shifting forces behind RMB internationalization: evidence from the 2025 Triennial Survey
title_zh: 人民币国际化背后的动力转变：来自2025年三年期调查的证据
authors: Robbert, Juliana, Sushko, Vladyslav, Westermann, Frank
official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper explores factors driving the internationalization of Renminbi (RMB) trading, using data from the 2025 BIS Triennial Survey of global foreign exchange turnover. We analyze both short-term (three-year) trading growth and long-term RMB turnover levels across jurisdictions. Unlike recent studies that struggled to identify sizable effects of real or financial links with China, we find that financial factors, especially banking links with China, play a key role, even over short horizons. These financial links reinforce market-driven "convergence" patterns, whereby RMB trading adjusts based on its under- or over-representation in total currency trading in a given location. However, this convergence is slower than previously reported, while financial drivers have grown in importance. For the long-term geographical distribution of RMB trading, financial links with China, including policy-driven variables such as qualified investor licenses, dominate, though trade links also contribute significantly. We also find that bilateral trade effects are stronger for cross-border RMB trading, and we report new insights on the dynamics in Asian financial centers and trading in spot versus derivatives.
abstract_zh: 本文利用2025年国际清算银行三年期全球外汇交易调查数据，探讨推动人民币交易国际化的因素。我们分析了各司法管辖区人民币交易的短期（三年）增长与长期交易规模。与近期难以发现与中国实体或金融联系具有显著影响的研究不同，我们发现金融因素（尤其是与中国的银行联系）即使在短期内也发挥关键作用。这些金融联系强化了市场驱动的“趋同”模式，即人民币交易根据其在特定地区总货币交易中的占比偏低或偏高进行调整。然而，这种趋同速度慢于此前报告，而金融驱动因素的重要性有所上升。就人民币交易的长期地理分布而言，与中国的金融联系（包括合格投资者牌照等政策驱动变量）占据主导地位，但贸易联系也贡献显著。我们还发现，双边贸易效应对跨境人民币交易更为显著，并报告了关于亚洲金融中心动态以及即期与衍生品交易的新见解。
